blocks.zh: Subpart D：研究者責任、GMP 義務與 CDMO 製造管控
blocks.en: Subpart D: Investigator Responsibilities, GMP Obligations and CDMO Manufacturing Controls

blocks.zh: 本章學習目標 Learning Objectives
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 掌握 §312.50–312.53 申辦者（Sponsor）對研究者的義務，包括合格研究者的選擇、IB 的提供、研究監測，以及如何將義務書面轉移給 CRO / Understand sponsor obligations to investigators under §312.50–312.53, including selection of qualified investigators, provision of IB, ongoing monitoring, and written transfer of obligations to CRO.
blocks.en: Understand sponsor obligations to investigators under §312.50–312.53, including selection of qualified investigators, provision of the IB, ongoing monitoring, and written transfer of obligations to a CRO.

blocks.zh: 理解 Form FDA 1572 的所有關鍵要素及法律效力，以及研究者簽署後承擔的所有義務 / Understand all critical elements of Form FDA 1572 and the full scope of obligations an investigator accepts upon signing.
blocks.en: Understand all critical elements of Form FDA 1572 and the full scope of obligations an investigator accepts upon signing.

blocks.zh: 解析 §312.60–312.62 研究者責任，特別是藥品處置記錄（drug disposition records）的法規要求與保存期限 / Analyze investigator responsibilities under §312.60–312.62, especially drug disposition record requirements and retention periods.
blocks.en: Analyze investigator responsibilities under §312.60–312.62, especially drug disposition record requirements and retention periods.

blocks.zh: 理解 GMP 如何在 Part 312 框架下適用於臨床試驗用藥，以及 Phase 1、Phase 2/3 和無菌注射劑的不同要求 / Understand how GMP applies to investigational drugs under Part 312, and the differing requirements for Phase 1, Phase 2/3, and sterile injectables.
blocks.en: Understand how GMP applies to investigational drugs under Part 312, and the differing requirements for Phase 1, Phase 2/3, and sterile injectables.

blocks.zh: 掌握 CDMO 在 Part 312 下的間接義務——透過品質協議、FDA 查廠權、IND CMC 部分——以及完整的 CDMO 與申辦者責任矩陣 / Understand CDMO indirect obligations under Part 312 through quality agreements, FDA inspection rights, and IND CMC sections, including the complete CDMO–Sponsor responsibility matrix.
blocks.en: Understand CDMO indirect obligations under Part 312 through quality agreements, FDA inspection rights, and IND CMC sections, including the complete CDMO–Sponsor responsibility matrix.

blocks.zh: 分析臨床暫停（Clinical Hold, §312.42）機制及 CDMO GMP 缺失如何觸發臨床暫停，造成嚴重商業影響 / Analyze the clinical hold mechanism under §312.42 and how CDMO GMP deficiencies can trigger a clinical hold with significant commercial consequences.
blocks.en: Analyze the clinical hold mechanism under §312.42 and how CDMO GMP deficiencies can trigger a clinical hold with significant commercial consequences.

blocks.zh: 4.1 §312.50–312.53 — Sponsor Obligations to Investigators 4.1 §312.50–312.53 — 申辦者對研究者的義務
blocks.en: 4.1 §312.50–312.53 — Sponsor Obligations to Investigators

blocks.zh: 導師解析 Tutorial Commentary
blocks.en: Tutorial Commentary

blocks.zh: 核心概念：申辦者義務的五大支柱
blocks.en: Core Concept: The Five Pillars of Sponsor Obligations

blocks.zh: §312.50 定義了申辦者對研究者的五大核心義務，可以用首字母記憶：SIPME
blocks.en: §312.50 defines five core sponsor obligations to investigators, which can be remembered by their initials: SIPME

blocks.zh: S — Select（選擇）： 選擇具備資格的研究者
blocks.en: S — Select: select qualified investigators

blocks.zh: I — Inform（告知）： 提供 Investigator's Brochure（IB）及所有必要資訊
blocks.en: I — Inform: provide the Investigator's Brochure (IB) and all necessary information

blocks.zh: P — Protocol compliance（協議合規）： 確保研究依照 IND 協議進行
blocks.en: P — Protocol compliance: ensure that the study is conducted in accordance with the IND protocol

blocks.zh: M — Monitor（監測）： 持續監測研究進展
blocks.en: M — Monitor: continuously monitor the progress of the study

blocks.zh: E — Emergent safety（緊急安全）： 立即通知 FDA 及所有研究者重大新增安全疑慮
blocks.en: E — Emergent safety: immediately notify FDA and all investigators of significant new safety concerns

blocks.zh: 這五大義務不能「授權給他人就免責」——即使轉移給 CRO，申辦者仍承擔最終責任。
blocks.en: These five obligations cannot be "delegated away" to escape liability: even when they are transferred to a CRO, the sponsor retains ultimate responsibility.

blocks.zh: 比喻：總承包商與分包商模型
blocks.en: Analogy: The General Contractor and Subcontractor Model

blocks.zh: 申辦者就像總承包商（General Contractor），承接了 FDA（業主）委託的「臨床試驗大樓工程」。CRO、研究者、CDMO 都是分包商（Subcontractors）。
blocks.en: The sponsor is like a general contractor that has taken on a "clinical trial building project" commissioned by FDA (the owner). The CRO, the investigators and the CDMO are all subcontractors.

blocks.zh: 關鍵法律邏輯：
blocks.en: The key legal logic:

blocks.zh: 總承包商可以把鋼筋工程外包給分包商（§312.52 轉移義務）
blocks.en: The general contractor may outsource the rebar work to a subcontractor (transfer of obligations under §312.52)

blocks.zh: 但如果鋼筋不合格，業主（FDA）找的是總承包商，不是分包商
blocks.en: But if the rebar is defective, the owner (FDA) holds the general contractor to account, not the subcontractor

blocks.zh: FDA 也有權直接查驗分包商工地（CRO 查廠權）
blocks.en: FDA also has the right to inspect the subcontractor's site directly (CRO inspection rights)

blocks.zh: 分包商若不遵規，和總承包商受到同等監管處分（CRO 同等監管標準）
blocks.en: If a subcontractor fails to comply, it is subject to the same regulatory action as the general contractor (equivalent regulatory standard for CROs)

blocks.zh: 這個邏輯直接解釋了為何申辦者要謹慎選擇 CRO 和 CDMO，並在品質協議中設置充分的管控機制。
blocks.en: This logic directly explains why sponsors must choose their CROs and CDMOs carefully, and put adequate controls in the quality agreement.

blocks.zh: CRO 義務轉移必須是書面的——口頭無效
blocks.en: Transfer of Obligations to a CRO Must Be in Writing: Verbal Agreements Are Invalid

blocks.zh: §312.51 的「書面（in writing）」要求不是行政形式：口頭協議將義務轉移給 CRO 是無效的。FDA 查廠時若找不到書面轉移協議，申辦者對 CRO 執行的所有義務仍然負責。
blocks.en: The "in writing" requirement of §312.51 is not a mere formality: a verbal agreement transferring obligations to a CRO is invalid. If FDA cannot find a written transfer agreement at inspection, the sponsor remains responsible for all obligations the CRO performed.

blocks.zh: 實務提醒：CRO 合約必須包含「義務轉移矩陣（obligation transfer matrix）」，明確列出哪些 Part 312 義務由 CRO 承擔。若只有一般性的「CRO 同意提供服務」條款，不符合 §312.51 的書面要求。
blocks.en: Practical reminder: the CRO contract must include an "obligation transfer matrix" that explicitly lists which Part 312 obligations the CRO assumes. A general clause such as "the CRO agrees to provide services" does not satisfy the written requirement of §312.51.

blocks.zh: 4.2 Form FDA 1572 — Statement of Investigator 4.2 Form FDA 1572 — 研究者聲明書
blocks.en: 4.2 Form FDA 1572 — Statement of Investigator

blocks.zh: 核心概念：FDA 1572 的法律地位
blocks.en: Core Concept: The Legal Status of FDA 1572

blocks.zh: FDA 1572 不是普通表格——它具有聯邦法律效力。關鍵點：
blocks.en: Form FDA 1572 is not an ordinary form; it has the force of federal law. Key points:

blocks.zh: 聯邦聲明（Federal Statement）： 簽署意味著向聯邦政府做出正式聲明；蓄意提供虛假資訊可依聯邦刑法 18 U.S.C. §1001 起訴
blocks.en: Federal statement: signing it is a formal statement to the federal government; knowingly providing false information may be prosecuted under federal criminal law, 18 U.S.C. §1001

blocks.zh: IRB 委任： 1572 上填寫的 IRB 就是 FDA 認定有責任審查本研究的機構——更換 IRB 需要申辦者知情並通知 FDA
blocks.en: IRB designation: the IRB named on Form 1572 is the body FDA regards as responsible for reviewing the study; changing the IRB requires that the sponsor be informed and FDA be notified

blocks.zh: Sub-investigator 義務連帶： 主要研究者（PI）對所有 1572 上列名的 sub-investigator 的行為負責
blocks.en: Sub-investigator obligations are linked: the principal investigator (PI) is responsible for the conduct of all sub-investigators listed on Form 1572

blocks.zh: IB 閱讀義務： 簽署 1572 代表研究者承諾已閱讀並理解 IB——若後來發生研究者不了解藥品已知風險的情況，1572 會成為重要的法律依據
blocks.en: Obligation to read the IB: by signing Form 1572 the investigator commits to having read and understood the IB; if an investigator is later found not to have understood the known risks of the drug, Form 1572 becomes an important legal basis

blocks.zh: 藥品處置記錄要求 — 每批次每受試者追蹤
blocks.en: Drug Disposition Record Requirements: Tracked by Lot and by Subject

blocks.zh:
藥品處置記錄必須追蹤（§312.62(a)）：

對每個批次（Lot）：
  ├── 收到數量（Received from sponsor）
  ├── 收到日期（Date received）
  ├── 批號（Lot number）
  └── 使用 / 返還 / 銷毀明細：
        ├── 分發給哪位受試者（Subject ID）
        ├── 每次給藥量（Dose per administration）
        ├── 給藥日期（Administration dates）
        ├── 剩餘量（Unused quantity）
        ├── 返還申辦者數量（Returned to sponsor）
        └── 銷毀記錄（Destroyed: method, date, witness）

每筆記錄必須可以追溯到：
  原始批號 → 受試者 → 給藥日期 → 結果（不良事件 / 療效）
blocks.en:
Drug disposition records must track (§312.62(a)):

For each lot:
  ├── Quantity received (Received from sponsor)
  ├── Date received
  ├── Lot number
  └── Details of use / return / destruction:
        ├── Which subject it was dispensed to (Subject ID)
        ├── Dose per administration
        ├── Administration dates
        ├── Unused quantity
        ├── Quantity returned to sponsor
        └── Destruction record (Destroyed: method, date, witness)

Every record must be traceable through:
  Original lot number → subject → administration date → outcome (adverse event / efficacy)

blocks.zh: 為何如此重要： 若臨床試驗中出現嚴重不良事件（SAE），FDA 及申辦者必須能追蹤「哪個批次的藥品給了哪個受試者」。記錄不全是臨床試驗中最常見的 Warning Letter 缺失之一。
blocks.en: Why this matters so much: if a serious adverse event (SAE) occurs in a clinical trial, FDA and the sponsor must be able to trace which lot of drug was given to which subject. Incomplete records are among the most common Warning Letter deficiencies in clinical trials.

blocks.zh: 記錄保存期限的雙重觸發機制
blocks.en: The Dual-Trigger Mechanism for Record Retention

blocks.zh: 記錄保存期限從兩個事件中較晚發生者起算 2 年：
blocks.en: The retention period runs for 2 years from the later of two events:

blocks.zh: 事件 A： 該藥品的 NDA/BLA 核准日
blocks.en: Event A: the NDA/BLA approval date for the drug

blocks.zh: 事件 B： 研究終止且 FDA 收到通知的日期
blocks.en: Event B: the date the study is terminated and FDA is notified

blocks.zh: 實務困難：研究者無法知道「NDA 何時獲批」。因此，申辦者有義務通知研究者 NDA 核准日期，以便研究者從該日起計算 2 年保存期限。品質協議通常包含「申辦者在 NDA 核准後 30 天內通知 CDMO」的條款。
blocks.en: Practical difficulty: an investigator cannot know "when the NDA is approved". The sponsor is therefore obliged to notify investigators of the NDA approval date, so that they can count the 2-year retention period from that date. Quality agreements often include a clause that "the sponsor shall notify the CDMO within 30 days of NDA approval".

blocks.zh: 4.3 §312.60–312.62 — Investigator Responsibilities 4.3 §312.60–312.62 — 研究者職責
blocks.en: 4.3 §312.60–312.62 — Investigator Responsibilities

blocks.zh: 核心概念：研究者 vs. 申辦者 vs. CDMO 責任分工
blocks.en: Core Concept: Division of Responsibilities among Investigator, Sponsor and CDMO

blocks.zh: Part 312 Subpart D 中，三個角色的責任分工如下：
blocks.en: Under Part 312 Subpart D, the responsibilities of the three roles are divided as follows:

blocks.zh: 申辦者（Sponsor）： 持有 IND、對整個試驗負最終責任、提供藥品給研究者
blocks.en: Sponsor: holds the IND, bears ultimate responsibility for the entire trial, and supplies the drug to investigators

blocks.zh: 研究者（Investigator）： 在臨床現場執行試驗、管理受試者、維護藥品控制記錄
blocks.en: Investigator: conducts the trial at the clinical site, manages subjects, and maintains drug control records

blocks.zh: CDMO： 製造臨床試驗用藥、維護生產批次記錄、提供 CMC 數據給申辦者的 IND
blocks.en: CDMO: manufactures the investigational drug, maintains production batch records, and provides CMC data for the sponsor's IND

blocks.zh: 三個角色各自有獨立的 FDA 查廠風險：FDA 可以分別查驗申辦者、研究者和 CDMO，發現的缺失可能成為臨床暫停的依據。
blocks.en: Each of the three roles carries its own FDA inspection risk: FDA may inspect the sponsor, the investigator and the CDMO separately, and deficiencies found may become grounds for a clinical hold.

blocks.zh: 比喻：藥品控制如同管制藥品物流
blocks.en: Analogy: Drug Control Is Like Controlled Substance Logistics

blocks.zh: §312.61 的藥品控制要求與管制藥品（Controlled Substances）的物流管理邏輯非常相似：
blocks.en: The drug control requirements of §312.61 closely resemble the logic of controlled substance logistics:

blocks.zh: 每個環節都要記錄： 就像嗎啡從藥局到病房每一步都要登記，臨床試驗用藥從 CDMO 到申辦者到研究者到受試者，每一步都要有帳
blocks.en: Every step is recorded: just as morphine must be logged at every step from the pharmacy to the ward, investigational drug must be accounted for at every step from the CDMO to the sponsor to the investigator to the subject

blocks.zh: 不能轉讓： 研究者不能把藥品給其他醫師使用，正如藥局不能把管制藥品轉給鄰近診所
blocks.en: No transfer: an investigator may not give the drug to other physicians to use, just as a pharmacy may not pass controlled substances to a neighboring clinic

blocks.zh: 剩餘量要歸還或銷毀： 試驗結束後，未使用的藥品必須依申辦者指示返還或銷毀，並保留證明
blocks.en: Remaining quantities must be returned or destroyed: after the trial, unused drug must be returned or destroyed as the sponsor directs, and proof must be retained

blocks.zh: 這個比喻幫助理解為何記錄要精確到「批號 × 受試者 × 每次給藥」的粒度。
blocks.en: This analogy helps explain why records must be precise down to the granularity of "lot number × subject × each administration".

blocks.zh: Case History vs. CRF — 兩者都是 §312.62(b) 要求
blocks.en: Case History vs. CRF — Both Are Required by §312.62(b)

blocks.zh: §312.62(b) 明確指出「case histories」包括兩個層次的文件：
blocks.en: §312.62(b) makes clear that "case histories" comprise two levels of documents:

blocks.zh: 原始醫療記錄（Source Documents）： 醫師進展記錄（progress notes）、住院病歷（hospital chart）、護理記錄（nurses' notes）——這些是「原始資料」
blocks.en: Source documents: physician progress notes, hospital chart, nurses' notes; these are the "original data"

blocks.zh: 臨床試驗記錄表（CRF, Case Report Form）： 從原始記錄中摘錄的標準化試驗數據表格
blocks.en: Case Report Form (CRF): a standardized data form abstracted from the source records

blocks.zh: 資料完整性重點： FDA 查廠時，若 CRF 數據與原始醫療記錄不一致，這是重大的 GCP 違規（data integrity violation）。兩者必須能相互核實（source data verification, SDV）。
blocks.en: Data integrity focus: at FDA inspection, if CRF data are inconsistent with the source medical records, this is a major GCP violation (data integrity violation). The two must be verifiable against each other (source data verification, SDV).

blocks.zh: 4.4 GMP Requirements for Investigational Drugs — The CDMO Perspective 4.4 研究用藥品的 GMP 要求 — CDMO 觀點
blocks.en: 4.4 GMP Requirements for Investigational Drugs — The CDMO Perspective

blocks.zh: 核心概念：為何 Phase 1 GMP 要求「最低但不是沒有」？
blocks.en: Core Concept: Why Is Phase 1 GMP "Minimal but Not Absent"?

blocks.zh: 2008 FDA 指引的核心邏輯：Phase 1 試驗的主要目的是確認安全性和藥物動力學，而非療效。這表示：
blocks.en: The core logic of FDA's 2008 guidance: the main purpose of a Phase 1 trial is to confirm safety and pharmacokinetics, not efficacy. This means:

blocks.zh: 受試者數量少（通常 10–30 人），但每位都是高風險志願者
blocks.en: The number of subjects is small (usually 10–30), but each is a high-risk volunteer

blocks.zh: 藥品品質直接影響 Phase 1 試驗的安全信號解讀——若藥品受到微生物污染或純度不足，安全信號可能是假陽性（污染物引起），或掩蓋藥品本身的真實毒性
blocks.en: Drug quality directly affects the interpretation of safety signals in a Phase 1 trial: if the drug is microbiologically contaminated or insufficiently pure, a safety signal may be a false positive (caused by the contaminant) or may mask the true toxicity of the drug itself

blocks.zh: 因此，「最低 GMP」不等於「沒有 GMP」：它等於確保藥品品質的最少必要管控
blocks.en: Therefore "minimal GMP" does not mean "no GMP": it means the minimum necessary controls to ensure drug quality

blocks.zh: 常見錯誤認知：小批量 = 不需要嚴格 GMP。正確認知：小批量 + 人體首次使用 = 每個批次的品質管控更加重要，因為沒有大批量數據平滑統計誤差。
blocks.en: Common misconception: small batch = no need for strict GMP. The correct view: small batch + first-in-human use = quality control of every batch matters more, because there is no large-batch data to smooth out statistical error.

blocks.zh: 無菌注射劑 Phase 1 的 GMP 底線不可妥協
blocks.en: The GMP Floor for Phase 1 Sterile Injectables Is Non-Negotiable

blocks.zh: 無論是 Phase 1 還是 Phase 2/3，無菌注射劑的非無菌（non-sterility）後果是立即且嚴重的：
blocks.en: Whether in Phase 1 or Phase 2/3, the consequences of non-sterility in a sterile injectable are immediate and severe:

blocks.zh: 靜脈注射受到細菌污染的藥品可在數小時內引起敗血症（sepsis）
blocks.en: Intravenous injection of a bacterially contaminated drug can cause sepsis within hours

blocks.zh: 歷史案例：2012 年美國新英格蘭複合藥局（NECC）事件，受污染的硬膜外類固醇注射劑導致 64 人死亡、750+ 人感染真菌性腦膜炎
blocks.en: Historical case: the 2012 New England Compounding Center (NECC) incident in the United States, in which contaminated epidural steroid injections caused 64 deaths and more than 750 cases of fungal meningitis and related infections

blocks.zh: Phase 1 安全試驗的悲劇反諷：若因 GMP 不足導致受試者感染，整個臨床計畫和安全數據庫都將受到質疑
blocks.en: The tragic irony for a Phase 1 safety trial: if inadequate GMP leads to infection of subjects, the entire clinical program and its safety database will be called into question

blocks.zh: CDMO 實務： 客戶常以「只是 Phase 1，規格可以寬鬆」為由要求降低無菌管控標準——這是錯誤且危險的要求。CDMO 應堅持無菌製程標準不因臨床階段而妥協。
blocks.en: CDMO practice: clients often ask for reduced sterility control standards on the grounds that "it is only Phase 1, so the specifications can be looser"; this is a wrong and dangerous request. A CDMO should insist that aseptic process standards are not compromised by clinical phase.

blocks.zh: 4.5 CDMO Obligations Under Part 312 (Indirect) 4.5 CDMO 在 Part 312 下的義務（間接）
blocks.en: 4.5 CDMO Obligations Under Part 312 (Indirect)

blocks.zh: 核心概念：CDMO 的「間接但真實」的 Part 312 義務
blocks.en: Core Concept: The CDMO's "Indirect but Real" Part 312 Obligations

blocks.zh: Part 312 不直接點名 CDMO，但 CDMO 在臨床試驗供應鏈中的四個綁定機制：
blocks.en: Part 312 does not name CDMOs directly, but there are four mechanisms that bind a CDMO in the clinical trial supply chain:

blocks.zh: 品質協議（Quality Agreement）： 申辦者透過合約將 Part 312 義務下傳至 CDMO
blocks.en: Quality Agreement: the sponsor passes Part 312 obligations down to the CDMO by contract

blocks.zh: FDA 查廠權（Inspection Rights）： FDA 可直接查廠，不需通過申辦者
blocks.en: Inspection Rights: FDA may inspect the facility directly, without going through the sponsor

blocks.zh: IND CMC 揭露（CMC Disclosure）： CDMO 被點名在 IND 中，資訊不符即違規
blocks.en: CMC Disclosure: the CDMO is named in the IND, and any inconsistency in the information is a violation

blocks.zh: 生產記錄支持（Record Support）： CDMO 記錄是申辦者 IND 報告的基礎資料
blocks.en: Record Support: CDMO records are the underlying data for the sponsor's IND reports

blocks.zh: 商業影響： CDMO 若發生重大 GMP 缺失，不只影響自身的 FDA 查廠結果——還可能觸發申辦者的 IND 臨床暫停（clinical hold），影響所有使用該 CDMO 製造藥品的臨床計畫。
blocks.en: Commercial impact: if a CDMO has a major GMP deficiency, it affects not only its own FDA inspection outcome but can also trigger a clinical hold on the sponsor's IND, affecting every clinical program that uses drug made by that CDMO.

blocks.zh: 比喻：CDMO 是 IND「不具名但可見」的夥伴
blocks.en: Analogy: The CDMO Is the IND's "Unnamed but Visible" Partner

blocks.zh: 想像 IND 是一場婚禮的主辦合約，申辦者是新人（IND 持有者），CDMO 是婚宴場地（製造設施）：
blocks.en: Imagine the IND as the host contract for a wedding, with the sponsor as the couple (the IND holder) and the CDMO as the banquet venue (the manufacturing facility):

blocks.zh: 合約上的名字是新人，但婚禮的成敗很大程度取決於場地的品質
blocks.en: The names on the contract are the couple's, but the success of the wedding depends heavily on the quality of the venue

blocks.zh: 如果場地發生食安問題（GMP 違規），整個婚禮（臨床計畫）都可能停擺
blocks.en: If the venue has a food safety problem (GMP violation), the whole wedding (clinical program) may grind to a halt

blocks.zh: 衛生局（FDA）可以直接查驗場地，不需要事先告知新人
blocks.en: The health department (FDA) can inspect the venue directly, without notifying the couple in advance

blocks.zh: 場地名稱必須在婚禮申報文件（IND CMC）中公開揭露
blocks.en: The venue's name must be publicly disclosed in the wedding filing documents (IND CMC)

blocks.zh: 結論：CDMO 雖不是「婚姻當事人」，但一旦出事，後果由所有人共同承擔。
blocks.en: Conclusion: although the CDMO is not a "party to the marriage", when something goes wrong, everyone shares the consequences.

blocks.zh: 製造偏差通知流程 — CDMO 的義務
blocks.en: Manufacturing Deviation Notification Flow — The CDMO's Obligations

blocks.zh: 當 CDMO 發生製造偏差時，Part 312 框架下的通知義務如下：
blocks.en: When a manufacturing deviation occurs at a CDMO, the notification obligations under the Part 312 framework are as follows:

blocks.zh: CDMO 內部調查： 偏差發生 → 隔離批次 → 啟動偏差調查（通常 24–72 小時內）
blocks.en: CDMO internal investigation: deviation occurs → quarantine the batch → start the deviation investigation (usually within 24–72 hours)

blocks.zh: 通知申辦者： 依品質協議規定的時限通知申辦者（通常重大偏差 24 小時內）
blocks.en: Notify the sponsor: notify the sponsor within the time limit set in the quality agreement (usually within 24 hours for a major deviation)

blocks.zh: 申辦者評估： 申辦者評估偏差是否需要 IND 修正（IND amendment）或安全報告
blocks.en: Sponsor evaluation: the sponsor evaluates whether the deviation requires an IND amendment or a safety report

blocks.zh: IND 修正決定： 若偏差影響藥品安全性或 CMC 資料，申辦者必須提交 IND 修正
blocks.en: IND amendment decision: if the deviation affects drug safety or CMC data, the sponsor must submit an IND amendment

blocks.zh: 監管機構通報： 若偏差可能影響受試者安全，申辦者依 §312.32 向 FDA 提交安全報告
blocks.en: Regulatory reporting: if the deviation may affect subject safety, the sponsor submits a safety report to FDA under §312.32

blocks.zh: 重要： CDMO 通知申辦者，申辦者決定是否通知 FDA——CDMO 不直接向 FDA 報告（除非 FDA 直接查廠時問及）。這個單向流程是 Part 312 責任結構的核心。
blocks.en: Important: the CDMO notifies the sponsor, and the sponsor decides whether to notify FDA; the CDMO does not report directly to FDA (unless asked when FDA inspects directly). This one-way flow is central to the Part 312 responsibility structure.

blocks.zh: CDMO–Sponsor Responsibility Matrix Under Part 312 CDMO 與申辦者在 Part 312 下的職責矩陣
blocks.en: CDMO–Sponsor Responsibility Matrix Under Part 312

blocks.zh: Practice Exercise: Allocate These Obligations Between Sponsor and CDMO / 練習：將以下義務分配給申辦者或 CDMO
blocks.en: Practice Exercise: Allocate These Obligations Between Sponsor and CDMO

blocks.zh:
The investigational drug batch fails in-process sterility bioburden testing. Who must report this to FDA?
批次中間控制無菌生物負荷測試不合格。誰必須向 FDA 報告？
blocks.en:
The investigational drug batch fails in-process sterility bioburden testing.
Who must report this to FDA?

blocks.zh:
FDA requests to inspect the cleanroom where the clinical drug is filled aseptically. Who hosts the inspection?
FDA 要求查驗臨床藥品無菌灌充的潔淨室。誰接待查廠？
blocks.en:
FDA requests to inspect the cleanroom where the clinical drug is filled aseptically.
Who hosts the inspection?

blocks.zh:
The sponsor wants to switch the filling site from CDMO-A to CDMO-B mid-trial. What must happen before the first batch is manufactured at CDMO-B?
申辦者希望在試驗中途將灌充現場從 CDMO-A 換至 CDMO-B。在 CDMO-B 生產第一批次前必須做什麼？
blocks.en:
The sponsor wants to switch the filling site from CDMO-A to CDMO-B mid-trial.
What must happen before the first batch is manufactured at CDMO-B?

blocks.zh:
A principal investigator is terminated mid-study for protocol deviations. Who must update Form FDA 1572?
一位主要研究者因協議偏差在試驗中途被終止資格。誰必須更新 FDA 1572？
blocks.en:
A principal investigator is terminated mid-study for protocol deviations.
Who must update Form FDA 1572?

blocks.zh: 4.6 Clinical Hold (§312.42) — The CDMO Business Risk 4.6 臨床暫停（§312.42）— CDMO 的商業風險
blocks.en: 4.6 Clinical Hold (§312.42) — The CDMO Business Risk

blocks.zh: 重點警示：CDMO GMP 缺失可暫停所有客戶的臨床計畫
blocks.en: Key Warning: A CDMO GMP Deficiency Can Suspend the Clinical Programs of All Its Clients

blocks.zh: 這是 CDMO 業務最重要的風險認知之一：
blocks.en: This is one of the most important risk awareness points in the CDMO business:

blocks.zh: 一個現場的 GMP 缺失 → 可能暫停所有使用該現場製造藥品的 IND 計畫
blocks.en: A GMP deficiency at one site → can suspend every IND program that uses drug made at that site

blocks.zh: 假設一個 CDMO 同時為 5 個客戶的 mAb Phase 2 計畫提供灌充充填服務：
blocks.en: Suppose a CDMO provides fill-finish services for mAb Phase 2 programs of 5 clients at the same time:

blocks.zh: 媒體灌充失敗 → FDA 發出 Warning Letter 觀察項目
blocks.en: Media fill failure → FDA issues Warning Letter observations

blocks.zh: FDA 評估後認為現場存在無菌保證風險
blocks.en: After evaluation, FDA concludes that the site presents a sterility assurance risk

blocks.zh: FDA 對所有使用該現場製造藥品的 IND 發出 Clinical Hold 通知
blocks.en: FDA issues clinical hold notices on all INDs that use drug made at that site

blocks.zh: 5 個臨床計畫全部暫停，受試者入組停止
blocks.en: All 5 clinical programs are suspended and subject enrollment stops

blocks.zh: 每個計畫的延誤成本：臨床試驗延誤每月可能造成數百萬至數千萬美元的損失（藥品開發成本 + 市場進入延遲）
blocks.en: Delay cost per program: a clinical trial delay can cost millions to tens of millions of US dollars per month (drug development cost + delayed market entry)

blocks.zh: CDMO 面臨客戶違約索賠、未來合約取消、聲譽損失
blocks.en: The CDMO faces breach-of-contract claims from clients, cancellation of future contracts and reputational damage

blocks.zh: 這就是為何 CDMO 的無菌製程管控和 GMP 合規不僅是監管義務，更是核心商業存活條件。
blocks.en: This is why a CDMO's aseptic process control and GMP compliance are not only regulatory obligations but also a core condition of commercial survival.

blocks.zh: 綜合情境：Phase 2 無菌注射劑 CDMO 媒體灌充失敗
blocks.en: Integrated Scenario: Media Fill Failure at a CDMO for Phase 2 Sterile Injectables

blocks.zh: 情境設定： 你是一家 CDMO 的 QA Director。你的現場為三個客戶製造 Phase 2 無菌 mAb 注射劑：
blocks.en: Scenario: You are the QA Director of a CDMO. Your site manufactures Phase 2 sterile mAb injectables for three clients:

blocks.zh: 客戶 A：腫瘤科 mAb，Phase 2 試驗進行中（50 位受試者），即將進入 Phase 3
blocks.en: Client A: oncology mAb, Phase 2 trial under way (50 subjects), about to move into Phase 3

blocks.zh: 客戶 B：自體免疫疾病 mAb，Phase 2 剛起步（10 位受試者），試驗計畫持續 18 個月
blocks.en: Client B: autoimmune disease mAb, Phase 2 just starting (10 subjects), with a trial plan running 18 months

blocks.zh: 客戶 C：罕見疾病 mAb，Phase 2，尚未給藥，下一批次預計在 3 週後供應
blocks.en: Client C: rare disease mAb, Phase 2, no dosing yet, next batch due to be supplied in 3 weeks

blocks.zh: 觸發事件： 你的灌充線媒體灌充試驗第二次連續失敗。第一次失敗 3 個月前已發生，根本原因調查認定為「人員換裝技術問題」，但調查文件顯示根本原因不完整，且後續 CAPA 只有「訓練複習」，沒有實質變更。
blocks.en: Triggering event: the media fill on your filling line has failed for the second consecutive time. The first failure occurred 3 months ago; the root cause investigation attributed it to "a personnel gowning technique problem", but the investigation documents show that the root cause was incomplete, and the subsequent CAPA consisted only of "refresher training", with no substantive change.

blocks.zh: 立即行動（前 72 小時）：
blocks.en: Immediate actions (first 72 hours):

blocks.zh: 啟動偏差報告，立即隔離所有在媒體灌充期間同步生產的商業批次（需要確認是否有）
blocks.en: Open a deviation report and immediately quarantine all commercial batches produced concurrently during the media fill period (confirm whether there are any)

blocks.zh: 依品質協議，在 24 小時內通知三位客戶的申辦者代表
blocks.en: Under the quality agreement, notify the sponsor representatives of all three clients within 24 hours

blocks.zh: 暫停所有正在進行的灌充作業，直到根本原因調查完成
blocks.en: Suspend all ongoing filling operations until the root cause investigation is complete

blocks.zh: 啟動增強型環境監測，取得基線數據
blocks.en: Start enhanced environmental monitoring to obtain baseline data

blocks.zh: 通知申辦者後的決策矩陣：
blocks.en: Decision matrix after notifying the sponsors:

blocks.zh: 客戶 A： 現有受試者已給藥的批次未受此次媒體灌充失敗影響（灌充日期在失敗前）。申辦者評估是否需要 IND 修正或安全報告
blocks.en: Client A: the batches already dosed to current subjects were not affected by this media fill failure (the filling dates preceded the failure). The sponsor evaluates whether an IND amendment or safety report is required

blocks.zh: 客戶 B： 同上，但申辦者需評估未來批次的供應計畫
blocks.en: Client B: same as above, but the sponsor must evaluate the supply plan for future batches

blocks.zh: 客戶 C： 下一批次計畫暫停，CDMO 必須在媒體灌充問題解決前不得製造
blocks.en: Client C: the next batch is put on hold; the CDMO must not manufacture until the media fill problem is resolved

blocks.zh: FDA 互動準備：
blocks.en: Preparing for FDA interaction:

blocks.zh: 準備完整的調查報告：兩次媒體灌充失敗的連結分析、根本原因（重新評估）、CAPA（具體措施，不只是訓練）
blocks.en: Prepare a complete investigation report: linkage analysis of the two media fill failures, root cause (re-evaluated), and CAPA (specific measures, not just training)

blocks.zh: 若 FDA 宣布現場查廠（surveillance inspection 或 directed inspection）：所有批次記錄、EM 趨勢、媒體灌充記錄必須立即可提供
blocks.en: If FDA announces an on-site inspection (surveillance inspection or directed inspection): all batch records, EM trends and media fill records must be immediately available

blocks.zh: 若 FDA 發出臨床暫停：三個客戶的申辦者必須準備 IND 臨床暫停回應，CDMO 必須提供完整的技術支持文件
blocks.en: If FDA issues a clinical hold: the sponsors of all three clients must prepare IND clinical hold responses, and the CDMO must provide complete technical supporting documents

blocks.zh: 商業教訓： 第一次媒體灌充失敗後的 CAPA 不足是本次危機的根本。CAPA 有效性驗證（CAPA effectiveness check）必須真實核實問題解決，而非形式性結案。
blocks.en: Business lesson: the inadequate CAPA after the first media fill failure is the root of this crisis. CAPA effectiveness checks must genuinely verify that the problem has been resolved, not close the CAPA as a formality.

blocks.zh: Chapter Summary — Section 4 本章重點摘要
blocks.en: Chapter Summary — Section 4

blocks.zh: 本章重點摘要（繁體中文）
blocks.en: Key Points Summary (Commentary)

blocks.zh: §312.50–312.53：申辦者–研究者–CRO 三角關係
blocks.en: §312.50–312.53: The Sponsor–Investigator–CRO Triangle

blocks.zh: 申辦者對整個 IND 試驗承擔最終責任。義務可以書面轉移給 CRO，但申辦者對 CRO 的失敗仍負責。Form FDA 1572 是將研究者與監管框架綁定的承諾文件——它是具有潛在聯邦刑事責任的正式聲明。
blocks.en: The sponsor bears ultimate responsibility for the entire IND trial. Obligations can be transferred to a CRO in writing, but the sponsor remains responsible for the CRO's failures. Form FDA 1572 is the commitment document that binds the investigator to the regulatory framework; it is a formal statement carrying potential federal criminal liability.

blocks.zh: §312.60–312.62：研究者操作義務
blocks.en: §312.60–312.62: Investigator Operational Obligations

blocks.zh: 研究者必須嚴格控制臨床試驗用藥——不得在 IND 框架外轉讓或使用。藥品處置記錄必須追蹤從批次收受到受試者給藥再到返還或銷毀的每個單位，可追溯至具體批號、受試者和日期。所有記錄必須保存至 NDA 核准後 2 年，或試驗終止且 FDA 通知後 2 年——以較晚者為準。
blocks.en: Investigators must strictly control investigational drug; it may not be transferred or used outside the IND framework. Drug disposition records must track every unit from receipt of the batch, to administration to the subject, to return or destruction, and be traceable to the specific lot number, subject and date. All records must be retained until 2 years after NDA approval, or 2 years after the study is terminated and FDA is notified, whichever is later.

blocks.zh: GMP 標準：隨臨床階段調整，安全性底線不妥協
blocks.en: GMP Standards: Scaled to Clinical Phase, with No Compromise on the Safety Floor

blocks.zh: Phase 1 要求最低 CGMP（書面程序、鑑別/強度/純度測試、可追溯批次記錄、失敗調查、訓練記錄）。Phase 2/3 要求完整的 21 CFR Parts 210/211。無論臨床階段，無菌注射劑都需要完整的無菌製程管控——因為非無菌注射的安全後果是立即且可能致命的。
blocks.en: Phase 1 requires minimal CGMP (written procedures, identity/strength/purity testing, traceable batch records, failure investigations, training records). Phase 2/3 requires full 21 CFR Parts 210/211. Regardless of clinical phase, sterile injectables require full aseptic process control, because the safety consequences of a non-sterile injection are immediate and potentially fatal.

blocks.zh: CDMO 義務：間接但後果重大
blocks.en: CDMO Obligations: Indirect but with Major Consequences

blocks.zh: CDMO 透過四個機制被綁定：品質協議、FDA 查廠權、IND CMC 揭露要求，以及為申辦者 IND 提供製造記錄支持。責任矩陣顯示 CDMO 擁有批次記錄、GMP 執行、驗證和環境監測——申辦者擁有 IND 提交、安全報告決策、研究者管理和 CMC 部分編寫。
blocks.en: A CDMO is bound through four mechanisms: the quality agreement, FDA inspection rights, IND CMC disclosure requirements, and manufacturing record support for the sponsor's IND. The responsibility matrix shows that the CDMO owns batch records, GMP execution, validation and environmental monitoring, while the sponsor owns IND submissions, safety report decisions, investigator management and authoring of the CMC section.

blocks.zh: 臨床暫停：最高風險結果
blocks.en: Clinical Hold: The Highest-Risk Outcome

blocks.zh: FDA 可基於 CDMO 的製造缺失發出臨床暫停。製造原因的臨床暫停可能暫停使用該 CDMO 製造藥品的所有臨床計畫——跨越所有申辦者客戶。FDA 的 30 天回應要求適用於申辦者的完整回應，而不是 CDMO 的底層調查（後者可能需要數個月）。CDMO 必須理解：其 GMP 合規直接保護客戶的臨床計畫和自身的商業存活能力。
blocks.en: FDA may issue a clinical hold based on a CDMO's manufacturing deficiencies. A manufacturing-related clinical hold may suspend all clinical programs that use drug made by that CDMO, across all sponsor clients. FDA's 30-day response requirement applies to the sponsor's complete response, not to the CDMO's underlying investigation (which may take months). A CDMO must understand that its GMP compliance directly protects its clients' clinical programs and its own commercial survival.

blocks.zh: 本章核心記憶點 — CDMO 角度完整責任圖
blocks.en: Key Takeaways — The CDMO's Complete Responsibility Picture

blocks.zh: Part 312 不直接點名 CDMO，但 CDMO 的行動影響申辦者的所有 IND 義務
blocks.en: Part 312 does not name CDMOs directly, but CDMO actions affect all of the sponsor's IND obligations

blocks.zh: 四個綁定機制： 品質協議 → FDA 查廠 → CMC 揭露 → 記錄支持
blocks.en: Four binding mechanisms: quality agreement → FDA inspection → CMC disclosure → record support

blocks.zh: 媒體灌充失敗 → 潛在臨床暫停 → 所有客戶計畫受影響 → 重大商業損失
blocks.en: Media fill failure → potential clinical hold → all client programs affected → major commercial loss

blocks.zh: 無菌注射劑的 GMP 標準不因 Phase 1 而降低——這是安全的底線，不是行政選項
blocks.en: GMP standards for sterile injectables are not lowered for Phase 1; this is the safety floor, not an administrative option

blocks.zh: FDA 1572 的法律效力意味著研究者管理是申辦者最高優先的合規責任
blocks.en: The legal force of Form FDA 1572 means that investigator management is the sponsor's highest-priority compliance responsibility
